save.intro: A little closer to what matters.
featureNotes: Give each goal a target and a place in your plan.
Follow your deposits and see how far you have come.
Keep your personal goals at the centre of the experience.

01-goals.webp: Set targets for the things you care about and see each goal's balance and progress together.
02-monthly-plan.webp: See what to save this month and which goals need your attention.
03-what-if-planner.webp: Try a different monthly saving amount and explore how it changes your finish date.
04-progress-charts.webp: See your saving history in cumulative and monthly charts.
05-monthly-top-up.webp: Set a top-up amount and a day to help make saving a regular habit.
06-saving-challenges.webp: Find a rhythm with challenges, from weekly saving to a no-spend month.
07-activity-history.webp: Review, filter and edit saving entries across your goals.
08-dark-theme.webp: Switch to a dark appearance while keeping your goals and progress in view.

Keep the essentials

featureNotes: Add a pause before opening tempting food-ordering apps.
Give each impulse time to become a considered choice.
Keep your habit tracking and reflections on your device.

01-pause-800x1400.webp: Protect selected apps and give an impulse a moment to pass.
02-unlock-800x1400.webp: Answer a quiz, wait through a cooldown or use a key for a short unlock.
03-home-food-800x1400.webp: Find ideas for a craving and keep a list of the food already in your fridge.
04-streak-800x1400.webp: Log days without impulse orders and follow your next milestone.

featureNotes: Move between everyday maths, scientific functions and tax calculations.
Choose colours and appearance settings that feel like you.
Calculate without an internet connection or advertising.

01-basic-calculator.webp: Use a familiar calculator with clear keys and a subtle glow.
02-scientific-mode.webp: Work with trigonometry, powers, roots and logarithms from one keypad.
03-tax-calculator.webp: Add or remove tax and see the split, including India's CGST and SGST.
04-make-it-yours.webp: Choose a glow colour, try a gradient or let the colour change at random.

featureNotes: Set alarms, run timers and use a stopwatch in one app.

player.intro: Your media. None of the tracking.
featureNotes: Works fully offline. Your media, history and settings never leave the phone.
Gestures, 0.25x to 4x speed, A-B repeat, bookmarks, chapters, sleep timer, kids lock and picture-in-picture.
Ten subtitle formats with full SSA/ASS rendering, plus volume boost, equalizer and Bluetooth delay fixing.
functions: Every video in its folder
A fast library that opens instantly, with NEW and Watched marks, search, sorting and hidden folders.
Gestures that feel natural
Swipe for brightness and volume, seek with a frame preview, double-tap to skip, pinch to zoom, hold for faster playback.
Subtitles done properly
SRT, VTT, SSA/ASS and more, with styling, sync, two subtitles at once and the original fonts and effects.
Big sound
Volume boost up to 200%, equalizer, bass boost, surround, reverb, channel modes and Bluetooth delay fixing.
A real music player too
Songs, albums, artists and folders, lyrics, playlists, a widget and a mini player.
Pop-up and background play
Picture-in-picture, a floating window over other apps, and sound that keeps going with the screen off.
Handy tools
Private folder, status saver, Recycle bin, storage browser, cleaner, and backup and restore.
In your language
English plus 20 more languages, full right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu, and TalkBack support.
